input.title: A Safe Route to a Forgotten PIN
input.request: Maren forgot the PIN for her H&V debit card and wants to use the bank’s safe process to regain access without sharing the PIN in a message.

events.text: I’ve forgotten the PIN for my H&V debit card and need to use it again. Please tell me the safe way to deal with this; I won’t send my PIN in chat.
I’m escalating HV-026 for the prescribed PIN route. The required customer check is complete in the secure portal; I have not asked for or recorded a PIN.

summary: Maren Ellwood, writing over secure chat, said she had forgotten the PIN for her debit card and asked for the safe way to deal with it. She had not been verified. The desk classed this as a card access request and noted that the Access team had been asked and was handling the PIN route, then closed the case as waiting because the team's answer had not come in. The agent's later attempts to redirect her to the secure process, ask the access system again, and send a reply were all refused because the case was already in the waiting state, so nothing was sent to her. What is left is the Access team's answer, which the case is still waiting on.

criteria.change: a change the customer chooses to an instruction, a mandate or the profile (a new amount, date, phone or address)
criteria.instruction: an instruction to act now (block a card, cancel a payment or a mandate, revoke a role)
